context: A boss and his manager debate world headlines over coffee
purpose: Teach: メキシコ/ピーター/ジョージ/ジャック/マイケル/トム/チベット/靖国

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今朝のニュース見たか？メキシコの大統領がまた何か言ってたぞ。
lines.en: Did you see the news this morning? The Mexican president was saying something again.
lines.style: Gruff executive tone with morning irritation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ああ、見ましたよ。記者のジョージさんが鋭い質問を投げかけていましたね。
lines.en: Yeah, I saw it. The reporter George asked some pointed questions, didn't he.
lines.style: Polite subordinate offering measured, slightly hedging commentary.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ジョージか。あの番組の司会者、確かトムさんだったよな。妙に落ち着いてた。
lines.en: George, huh. The host of that program was Tom, right? He was strangely calm.
lines.style: Opinionated and conversational with confident bluster.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: そうですね。後半でジャックさんという解説者も出てきて、別の角度から話してました。
lines.en: Right. Later a commentator named Jack came on and discussed it from another angle.
lines.style: Bringing additional context with deferential, careful phrasing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ふむ。うちの会社のコンサルのマイケル、あいつなら何て言うかな。
lines.en: Hmm. Our company's consultant Michael, I wonder what he'd say.
lines.style: Musing aloud while name-dropping a familiar acquaintance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 今度ピーター部長と一緒に来日するそうですから、その時に伺ってみては？
lines.en: Apparently he's coming to Japan with Director Peter soon, so maybe ask him then?
lines.style: Practical suggestion delivered with respectful business register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: いいな。それより中国とチベットの問題、最近どう動いてる？
lines.en: Good idea. More importantly, how is the China-Tibet issue moving lately?
lines.style: Dismissive pivot toward a heavier geopolitical topic.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 膠着状態らしいです。日本も靖国の話題が出るとまた揉めますし、難しいですよね。
lines.en: Apparently it's at a stalemate. When Yasukuni comes up here too, things get messy. It's tough.
lines.style: Thoughtful, careful navigation of sensitive political subjects.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 全くだ。コーヒーもう一杯頼むか。話の続きはそれからにしよう。
lines.en: Absolutely. Shall we order another coffee? Let's continue the discussion after that.
lines.style: Boss closing the round with a casual command.
